steps.say: **Add students** puts a pupil who is already in your school into this class. Opening it changes nothing on its own.
The list holds the pupils in your school who are not in this class yet, with the classes they are in now under each name. Type a few letters to narrow it.
Tapping a name adds that pupil straight away, and they bring everything they have already learned with them. Adding does not take them out of any other class.
The same button reads **Done** while the list is open. For a pupil with no account at all, use the class link in **Invite students** instead.
steps.terminal: That's adding students — search, tap, done. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
